learning_outcomes.text: Explain the role and independence of internal audit
Build a risk-based annual audit plan
Scope an individual audit engagement with clear objectives
Gather and document sufficient appropriate audit evidence
Write findings and recommendations that drive remediation

integrative_case: A new internal auditor is asked to review the procurement process: build a risk-based scope, select a reliable evidence mix, test the key controls, document working papers, and write findings with root cause and agreed management actions for the audit committee.
